The '''Old Man''' was the nickname of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the leader of [[Ghost cell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around [[3643 BBY|the final]] [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he was killed by [[Cipher Nine]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In their last conversation, Cipher Nine can opt to spare the Old Man (for light side points), after which the Old Man commits suicide, or kill him outright (for dark side points).

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
